info.name: HustleHub+ Part 2
info.description: MongoDB marketplace workflow: authentication, gigs, bookings, transactions, and a freelancer tax estimate.

exec: pm.test('Health endpoint is available', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Freelancer registered or already exists', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 400]); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) pm.environment.set('freelancerToken', pm.response.json().token);
pm.test('Freelancer can create a gig', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.environment.set('gigId', pm.response.json().gig._id);
pm.test('Client registered or already exists', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 400]); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) pm.environment.set('clientToken', pm.response.json().token);
pm.test('Gig list is available', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Client can book the gig', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Freelancer bookings are available', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Freelancer transactions are available', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Freelancer tax estimate is authorized', function () {
pm.response.to.have.status(200);
pm.test('Tax estimate includes income, tax, and net income', function () {
const estimate = pm.response.json();
pm.expect(estimate.totalIncome).to.be.a('number');
pm.expect(estimate.estimatedTax).to.be.a('number');
pm.expect(estimate.netIncome).to.be.a('number');
pm.expect(estimate.netIncome).to.eql(estimate.totalIncome - estimate.estimatedTax);
pm.environment.set('timestamp', Date.now());
